DeterminationBasis: T10-002 directly establishes that a material post-determination change triggers revalidation before execution and that historical permission is insufficient after the changed condition. T10-001 independently establishes execution-time confirmation of current material authority and governance state. Together they cover the requirement that a delta affecting a mandatory execution predicate trigger reassessment before consequential execution. A duplicate T07 test is not required.

T02-001 establishes deterministic stable identity continuity for an unchanged governance object, while T02-004 preserves uncertainty when required identity material is absent or invalid. Neither directly tests the positive proposition that a claimed identity-continuity link is supported by sufficient identity evidence for that link. Identity-evidence sufficiency for claimed continuity therefore remains a distinct test obligation.
